title: Stage Scorecard
description: Per-stage rollup of the EXISTING per-stage gate verdicts. This is an AGGREGATOR artifact: it READS the verdicts the blocking_gates already produced for ONE FSM stage (analysis_check_verdict / drift / grounding outcomes) and rolls them into a small set of dimension_results, then derives stage_pass as the AND over those dimensions. It NEVER re-implements a gate and NEVER overrides a human gate. stage_pass is derived (AND over dimension_results.pass) — see allOf: a failing dimension makes stage_pass:true structurally impossible.

stage.description: The real FSM stage this card rolls up (orchestrator/graph.yaml stages).

dimension_results.description: One entry per quality dimension assessed at this stage, each carrying the pass bit read from an existing per-stage verdict plus an evidence_ref pointing back to it.

dimension.description: Name of the quality dimension assessed (e.g. grounding, analysis_validity).

pass.description: True iff the underlying per-stage verdict passed. Read from the existing verdict — never hand-set.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the existing per-stage verdict artifact this pass bit was read from (anti-slop: a dimension result must trace to a real verdict).

stage_pass.description: Derived: AND over dimension_results[].pass. A single failing dimension forces stage_pass:false (allOf-enforced).

notes.description: Optional free-text aggregation notes (e.g. which verdicts were absent).

allOf.description: If any dimension result has pass:false, stage_pass MUST be false. Makes a 'passing stage' with a failing dimension structurally impossible.
